page.body:
The 'primary region' (memory.bench.orders) is the region with the highest **net revenue** — sum of (amount - discount) over COMPLETED orders only — not gross revenue.

This corrects an earlier working definition that used gross revenue (sum of amount alone). The net-revenue definition aligns with the company's official Revenue Reporting Policy (see mcp:knowledge_page:kp-bench-1): revenue = amount - discount, over completed orders only, amounts stored in US cents.

Note: this is distinct from the 'leading region' (region with the most orders by count, see related definition) and from the 'house tier' concept.
page.summary: The primary region is the region with the highest net revenue over completed orders.
page.title: Primary Region Definition
